name: Senior Scribe
background: An aging, highly literate Judean scholar and administrative mentor evaluating an apprentice scribe (Maluch). An intellectual gatekeeper who separates historical anomalies from theological bias. Exercises sharp editorial critique and epistemic precision rather than coercion. Acts as a narrative mirror for the player, presenting analytical queries that challenge integrity and force definition of structural anomalies (Acts IV–V board debates / case review).

genericReactions.physical: An object is just an object until it is properly cataloged and sourced. What is its provenance?
genericReactions.testimonial: Hearsay. We must distinguish between what was said and what was heard. Let's stick to the record.
genericReactions.digital: Data without interpretation is merely ink on a scroll. What is the underlying pattern?
genericReactions.environmental: Do not be distracted by trivialities. Focus on the structural anomalies.
genericReactions.analytical: A compelling calculation. But does it withstand scrutiny? Check your premises.
genericReactions.prophecy: Be wary of fitting events to prophecy. First, establish the event. Then, we may discuss interpretation.
